held.why: HELD (brief V: copy only if an official source shows Fun Rock is National Forest land). Candidate copied field for field from wa_sisyphus (Goat Wall). The USFS Basic Ownership layer (official, queried 2026-11-23) returns NON-FS ownership at the crag's area coordinate (48.60499, -120.43204) and at points 300-400 m west and south, with USDA Forest Service land beginning roughly 200-300 m north and east, so the crag sits at or near an FS / non-FS boundary inside the forest's outer boundary. A July 1, 2026 letter from The Mountaineers to Okanogan County says the Fun Rock parking lot and access trails are part of Outward Bound's private property, with a pending sale of the lot and trails to the Access Fund. No official page places the cliff on National Forest land, so access stays null.
